eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LOCAL AREA EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Gunnison, CO; at 1:32 PM on JUL 26, 2026 Effective until 1:32 PM JUL 27, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: The Gunnison County Sheriff has issued a Pre-Evacuation Notice for Almont and Lower Taylor Canyon in Gunnison County due to a new wildfire start in Taylor Canyon. This includes all of Almont and the Lower Taylor Canyon to Hwy 135 south to Roper Lane, including the Three Rivers Resort. Be prepared to evacuate. Call 970-641-7660 for questions.
